limitations: The archive preserves exact original UTF-8 input-file bytes. Many inputs are explicitly derived receipts/audits; exact retention of those files does not turn their selected semantic projections into complete raw provider responses or traces.

The complete original accepted native receipt and its exact decoded detail are retained. Original application PNG hex is replaced only as disclosed there by verified lengths/hashes; original ZIPs, standalone PNGs and native driver/render logs remain expiring supplements. Hashes cannot reconstruct omitted raw image bytes.

The ordinary proof retains four exact original plan/aggregate files. Provider/log/report fields and twelve raw callback arrays use the explicitly disclosed semantic projection/count/hash representation; raw omitted arrays and supplementary data cannot be reconstructed from hashes.

Native cursor snapshots are observations, not trusted-delivery acknowledgements or proof of a historical OS cause. Full current probe fields preserve their own bounded 393/336/57 system-log truncation and actual exported/inferred cleanup distinction.

The exact nine-file local postcommit addendum preserves the ENOBUFS recorder failure, immutable source attribution and after-check reconstruction. Reused focused controls keep their original execution attribution; no combined 63-test local execution is invented.

Both native processing attempts and collection failures remain exact historical processing records. The first 45,000-character refusal and intermediate ceiling-only copy do not constitute a native retry or a change to any acceptance bound.

The superseded browser shard audit and earlier partial stable-input audit are retained only as explicitly marked processing/pre-audit history. The corrected and complete output audits govern current interpretation; earlier erroneous derived counts and pending fields are not final acceptance.

The 7ce ordinary-CI cancellation/failure projection and SPN-139 postlanding context are historical records, not current SPN-137 acceptance. Historical native failures and external partial execution retain their maintained-source dispositions.

Prepublication source reviews and plan precede hosted acceptance. This package does not embed a review of itself, pre-credit its future archive commit, or establish an eventual guarded squash/cleanup/canonical-description result.

Listed credential-pattern checks complement independent review and do not constitute a universal secret detector. The builder packages data only; it neither authenticates GitHub nor performs product/native/test execution.
